description: This file defines a PHP class 'Table' in the OrangeHRM project, extending Doctrine's Schema Table class. It adds methods to set the schema manager, add columns with options, and create the table via the schema manager.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Extends Doctrine's Schema Table class to add schema management capabilities specific to OrangeHRM, including setting schema manager, adding columns with options, and creating the table.

methods.name: setSchemaManager
methods.description: Sets the schema manager instance used to execute database schema operations.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a column to the table with specified options and returns the current Table instance for chaining.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates the table in the database by executing the schema manager's createTable method.
